origins.section: A Private Constructor Stops new, and Nothing Else
Deserialization Makes a Second Instance Without Running the Constructor
Each Class Loader Has Its Own Singleton, Enum Included
The Holder Idiom Chooses When the Instance Is Built; Only the Enum Refuses Copies

gates.says: all 5 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-framework-before-getinstance: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-framework-before-getinstance: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-framework-before-getinstance: Page: 'The lazy field is still null when reflection comes first, so the copy gets through, and getInstance() builds another.' Output 'lazy: reflected first, then getInstance() == it: false'.
recorded.prompt:q-replicated-session: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-replicated-session: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-replicated-session: 'Deserialization never calls it: it allocates the object, runs the no-arg constructor of the first superclass that isn't Serializable ... The guard never runs'; output copy == INSTANCE: false. Caveat: shown in one process, not across nodes.

recorded.pass:q-two-webapps-enum: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-two-webapps-enum: 'a class is identified by its name and the loader that defined it ... Application servers give each web application its own loader ... a library jar copied into two of them is loaded twice'; 'QuotaEnum: same instance in A and B? false'.
recorded.prompt:q-holder-cache: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-holder-cache: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-holder-cache: Matrix and Reference: holder class 'second instance' under serialization; 'By itself it protects against none of the three attacks.'
recorded.prompt:q-reset-hook-parallel: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-reset-hook-parallel: 'works only while every test class remembers to call it and while tests run one at a time: with JUnit's parallel execution on, two tests share the instance while both are running.'
